title: Intern - Advanced Packaging TD
description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Join Micron’s Advanced Packaging Technology Development (TD) team, where innovation and precision come together to develop next-generation interconnect technologies. The team develops solutions designed to improve semiconductor performance, reliability, and advanced packaging capabilities. As an Advanced Package TD Process Intern, you will collaborate with experienced engineers to support development of technologies including hybrid bonding, micro bump technology, Through-Silicon Vias (TSV), and thermal management. You will gain hands-on experience in structured problem-solving, line monitoring, data analysis, experimental design, and project management while contributing to process optimization and yield improvement. You will also leverage AI and Code Assist to develop Agent-based solutions that support engineering analysis and process development activities. Responsibilities Lead structured problem-solving activities using methodologies such as Kepner-Tregoe (KT) to address process and yield challenges. Define, complete, and analyze Design of Experiments (DoE) for advanced packaging and interconnect process development. Analyze process, line-monitoring, and yield data; develop new monitoring methods and critical metrics to support process optimization. Present technical findings and collaborate with engineering teams across sites and functional areas. Apply AI and Code Assist to develop Agent-based solutions that enhance data analysis, engineering workflows, or process monitoring. Minimum Qualifications Currently enrolled in an accredited university pursuing a Master’s degree or PhD in a semiconductor-related field, with an expected graduation date no earlier than Fall 2027 and no later than Summer 2028. Demonstrated experience with data extraction, statistical analysis, and technical reporting using tools such as JMP or comparable analytics tools. Demonstrated ability to collaborate and communicate technical findings across multi-functional teams. Ability to prioritize multiple technical projects, adapt to changing responsibilities, and deliver results within project timelines and resource constraints. Experience Using AI, Code Assist, or Agent-based solutions for technical analysis, engineering workflows, or related applications. Preferred Qualifications Experience with semiconductor process technologies, including advanced packaging, back-end-of-line (BEOL), advanced interconnect, hybrid bonding, micro bump technology, or TSV. Experience with structured problem-solving or decision-making methodologies such as Kepner-Tregoe (KT). Academic or research experience related to advanced packaging, interconnect technologies, or package thermal performance and thermal management. Experience designing experiments and performing statistical analysis using DoE, JMP, or comparable methods and tools. Demonstrated academic, research, or project experience related to advanced semiconductor packaging or interconnect development. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . title: Validation/Char Eng Intern
description: Change the world. Love your job. The Validation/Characterization Engineering Intern at Texas Instruments are powered by a passion for continual improvement. Our solutions make a real difference and yours will, too. We make the semiconductor product design process easier and faster, which helps our customers succeed in today's fast-paced marketplace. In this role, you'll support the development and implementation of strategies that achieve profitability targets on assigned TI product lines through new product development, cost reduction, capacity expansion and yield enhancement projects. You'll serve in development and implementation of cost-effective analog test techniques, resolve customer quality and application issues, and facilitate cross-functional teams for problem solving. You will collaborate with Analog Design on design-for-test features and Applications team on validation, while also tackling challenging problems in achieving analog performance testing on ATE multi-site hardware. These teams develop differentiating innovations in the test domain, ranging from methods to lower test cost for TI without compromising quality, to identifying design improvements for test, and resolving complex technical problems requiring an individual to transcend multiple domains. Minimum requirements: Pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher Preferred qualifications: Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery Why TI? The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us. Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture . At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings . About Texas Instruments Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. The work spans everything from capturing high-quality signing data to training and evaluating models and integrating them into product. This is for a 2027 summer internship. Reviews current developments and proactively seeks new knowledge that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale. Coursework, projects, or prior experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, or data science. Understanding of machine learning concepts, model evaluation, retrieval systems, large language models, or prompt engineering. Experience using Python or other relevant programming languages through coursework, research, personal projects, or equivalent practical work, including effective use of AI-assisted development tools. Interest in computer vision, language technology, accessibility, or human-computer interaction. Reliable problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. title: Intern - Process Integration, Advanced Packaging
description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Micron’s Wafer Level Packaging Technologies Team is at the forefront of developing advanced interconnect and packaging solutions that enable next-generation memory technologies. Based in Boise, Idaho, the team collaborates across engineering fields to define technology requirements, build program plans, and drive innovation in process integration. As an Advanced Package TD Process Integration Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to support the development of sophisticated interconnect technologies. This internship offers hands-on experience in problem-solving, experimental design, line monitoring, and data analysis, contributing directly to yield improvement and process optimization. Responsibilities Lead problem-solving activities using structured methodologies such as Kepner-Tregoe (KT) Define and implement Design of Experiments (DoE) for process development Communicate findings across local and global teams and present results to partners Support line monitoring through project management and yield improvement initiatives Develop new line monitoring methods and define critical metrics Conduct experimental work using Micron systems and document outcomes Analyze experimental results and provide clear, actionable recommendations Proficient in the use of AI tools, workflows and agents to maximize learning.
